Create one clean pixel-art reference atlas for the existing NPC078 afraid/thinking eyes. Use the single attached image as the exact character, emotion, palette, and phase reference. Preserve the anxious/fearful brows, their existing shape and position, the same worried expression, face spacing, pixel style, and warm muted colors.

Canvas and cell contract: one seamless 2-column by 2-row sheet, no outer margin, no gutters, no labels, no extra faces. Each cell has the same 64:35 aspect ratio as the reference cells. Match the reference canvas ratio 1024:560. Cell order: top-left = open eyes looking LEFT; top-right = open eyes looking RIGHT; bottom-left = half-blink eyes looking LEFT; bottom-right = half-blink eyes looking RIGHT. Keep the eye opening shapes and facial features aligned with their corresponding same-phase reference; only make the requested horizontal gaze distinction between left and right.

Eye details: preserve compact, irregular stepped/curved pixel iris clusters and pupils; keep each pupil fully inside its eye opening in every cell. Keep both upper and lower lids continuous around the eyeballs, including the half-blink cells. Use restrained muted iris highlights only. Avoid iris bars or square blocks, round vector-like disks, huge exposed white sclera, harsh white glints, disconnected lids, gaze drift between open and half phases, and any vertical iris movement. Preserve the source pixel-art edges; no smoothing, antialiasing, blur, text, watermark, or added decoration.
